flow.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《105》

en: The view from the window is verdant.
Banish yourself and bring it back

zh: 你是王維坐看的那片雲
en: You are the cloud that Wang Wei sat looking at.
Soothing curls sometimes, wet cold sometimes

zh: 光，有時是粒子，有時是波
風景，有時是滄海，有時是桑田
説法者曰，有相皆是虛妄
en: The preacher said, there are people who are false.

points.zh:
「 凡所有相皆是虛妄，若見諸相非相，即見如來。」
---- 《金剛經》
points.en:
“Every man is a liar, and if he sees things as they are, he sees the Tathagata.”
---- Diamond Sutra

en: Street lights twilight, late wind chill
Aquatic grass is fine, Fish says.

flow.caption_zh: 魚缸裡的魚。               ( 攝影/何康隆 )

points.zh: 「魚缸裡的魚」是一部音樂舞台劇，訴說人類與自然永續的想像故事， 由崇右技術學院演藝事業系的學生們，所創作的作品。 以阿美族原住民家庭成員為主角，省思環境家園與生命心靈的探索。 每個人心裡都有一個魚缸，那是受限的居所，或是真情的貯存場，這是一個只有自己才能決定答案。（原住民族文化事業基金會）
points.en: "Fish in the Fish Tank" is a musical stage drama that tells the imaginary story of the sustainability of humans and nature, created by students of the Performing Arts Department of the Chongyou Institute of Technology. Reflect on the exploration of environmental homes and the soul of life with members of Aboriginal Aramco families as the protagonists. Everyone has a fish tank in their heart, which is a restricted dwelling place, or a storehouse of truth, which is an answer that only they can decide. (Indigenous Peoples Cultural Enterprise Foundation)

points.zh:
唐 。劉禹錫《陋室銘》
山不在高，有仙則名。水不在深，有龍則靈。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上階綠，草色入簾青。談笑有鴻儒，往來無白丁。可以調素琴，閱金經。無絲竹之亂耳，無案牘之勞形。南陽諸葛廬，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？
points.en:
Tang Dynasty. Liu Yuxi "Mud Room Inscription"
The mountain is not high, it has a fairy name.The water is not deep, there are dragons and spirits.Si is a shabby room, but WU Dexin.The moss marks are green on the upper floor, and the grass enters the curtain.There is talk and jokes with Hong Ru, and there is no white din.You can tune the violin and the Pension Sutra.The disorderly ears of silkless bamboo, the labor of no case.Nanyang Zhuge Lu, Xishuzi Yunting.Confucius Cloud: How ugly is he?

zh: 好好下每一局，每一步棋
步步經營，讓我繼續輸給你
en: Walking on the chessboard, I just want to be with you
Run it step by step, let me keep losing to you

flow.caption_zh: 臺中國家歌劇院.  臺灣       ( 攝影/何康隆 )

en: Dreaming of returning to your hometown, starting to know
The streets have always been treasured

zh: 等待星空非常希臘的夜晚
en: I am a lone boat, drifting in
Waiting for a very Greek night in the stars

flow.caption_zh: 愛琴海的黃昏：駛向克里特島       （攝影/何康隆）

en: “There Was No Name for the Aegean Sea” (Excerpt)

zh: 憶起一則沒有謎底的神話
連神話的謎題也全然遺忘
古代的寓言已隨風而去
en: Reminds me of a myth with no mystery.
Even the mythical puzzles are completely forgotten.
Ancient parables have gone with the wind
There's nothing but blue in the sea.
Shrouded far away in the Aegean Sea

zh: 詩的字裡行間來回流轉
en: Poetry moves back and forth between the lines.

points.zh:
唐 。孟郊《遊子吟》
慈母手中線，遊子身上衣。
臨行密密縫，意恐遲遲歸。
誰言寸草心，報得三春暉。
points.en:
Tang Dynasty. Mengjiao "Youzi Yin"
Mother Lovingly holds the line in her hand and plays with the top.
The process is tightly seamed, meaning that it may be delayed.
Whoever speaks grass hearts will be rewarded with San Chunhui.
